STAGE=ROOT/'staging'/SHA
DEST=ROOT/'releases'/SHA
if ROOT.exists():raise RuntimeError('R41_INSTALL_ROOT_EXISTS_ABORT_NO_OVERWRITE')
def ghfetch(name):
 r=subprocess.run(['gh','api',f'repos/foto6/help-pc-2/contents/{name}?ref={SHA}'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=14)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('GH_FETCH_FAILED_'+name)
 j=json.loads(r.stdout)
 if j.get('encoding')!='base64':raise RuntimeError('UNEXPECTED_GH_ENCODING')
 body=base64.b64decode(j['content'])
 h=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(body)).encode()+bytes([0])+body).hexdigest()
 if h!=EXPECTED[name] or j.get('sha')!=h:raise RuntimeError('EXACT_GIT_BLOB_MISMATCH_'+name)
 return name,body
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 data=dict(pool.map(ghfetch,EXPECTED))

for name,body in data.items():
 p=STAGE/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(body)

if test.returncode:raise RuntimeError('R41_LOCAL_NODE_TESTS_FAILED_'+(test.stdout+test.stderr)[-1500:])

cfg=json.loads((DEST/'examples/pc-autonomy.example.json').read_text('utf8'))
cfg['state']=str(ROOT/'data/pc-control-supervisor.json')
cfg['r45']['state']=str(ROOT/'data/r45-coordinator.json')
ROOT.joinpath('config.json').write_text(json.dumps(cfg,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
run=subprocess.run(['node','bin/pc-autonomy-daemon.js','--config',str(ROOT/'config.json'),'--once'],cwd=DEST,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=18)
output=json.loads(run.stdout.strip()) if run.returncode==0 else {}
print(json.dumps({'status':'PC_CONTROL_R41_SHADOW_INSTALLED','exactSha':SHA,'blobCount':len(EXPECTED),'testExit':test.returncode,'localObserverExit':run.returncode,'observer':output,'observerErrorCode':run.stderr[-350:] if run.returncode else '', 'releasePath':str(DEST),'noSend':True,'noBrowserTabCreation':True,'productionUntouched':True},ensure_ascii=True)[:7500])
